title: Emulsion

inlines.v: EMUL'SION, noun [Latin emulsus, emulgeo, to milk out.] A soft liquid remedy of a color and consistence resembling milk; any milk-like mixture prepared by uniting oil and water, by means of another substance, saccharine or mucilaginous.
